# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

coastal_forest <- read_csv(here("data", "theme1_coastal_forest.csv"))
```

# Tasks

Using the `coastal_forest` dataset, calculate the following summary metrics **for each plot**:
1. The total number of trees (`n()`).
2. The average DBH (`mean()`).
3. The maximum height of trees (`max()`).

Write your grouping and summarization pipeline below:

```{r}
plot_summary <- coastal_forest %>% 
  group_by(plot_id) %>% 
  summarize(
    total_trees = n(),
    mean_dbh = mean(dbh_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_height = max(height_m, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(plot_summary)
```
